description: READ a snapshot of a TD network (node/connection counts plus any errors) and, optionally, a preview image of an output TOP, then WRITE a dated journal entry to Performances/<date>-<title>.md in the vault (the thumbnail is saved as a binary attachment). Use this to build a diary of your shows over time. Returns the note path, whether a thumbnail was saved, and the node/issue counts. Requires a configured TDMCP_VAULT_PATH.

comp_path.description: Network to snapshot for the log.

height.description: Thumbnail height in pixels for the captured output_path preview.

notes.description: Free-form notes: what played, what worked.

output_path.description: TOP to capture as the entry's thumbnail.

title.description: Short title for the entry (e.g. venue or set name).

width.description: Thumbnail width in pixels for the captured output_path preview.

name: log_performance
title: Log a performance to the vault
